title: Azure Hub-Spoke Network
prompt: Create an Azure hub-spoke network architecture diagram. Include on-premises datacenter, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute circuit, hub VNet, Azure Firewall, Azure Bastion, Private DNS Resolver, shared services subnet, management subnet, two spoke VNets for workload A and workload B, peering links, route tables/UDRs, NSGs, application subnets, data subnets, private endpoints, Log Analytics, and Azure Monitor. Show on-prem to hub connectivity, hub-to-spoke routing through the firewall, private endpoint access, and monitoring flows. Group by subscription, region, hub, spokes, and subnets.
